content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to adjust the inrush current manually on my [product_name] with [article_no]? I'm switching from incandescent bulbs to LED bulbs.
Manual adjustment isn't available. Please refer to the note regarding the delivery release for the [product_name] inrush current limiter [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for manual inrush current adjustment on a specific [product_name] module. Replies clarify that manual configuration is not supported and recommend using the corresponding inrush current limiter accessory. This reveals an expectation for user-configurable hardware that is not met by the existing product design.
analysis.user_expectations: The user assumes they can manually control inrush current settings on their [product_name] to better support different load types.
